definitions.u2: etco2<10, 1s grid, ffill cap 10s, merge gap 10s (no unknown), min duration 10s; reliable = >=2 actual low reading runs associated with event grid cells
definitions.support_association: a raw low run counts if it is the ffill source of at least one low grid cell inside [start,end); its source sample may precede the integer-second event start, within the cap
definitions.u2_low_support: <2 associated EtCO2<10 readings; ignore, not positive/negative
definitions.rr3: rr<3, 1s grid, ffill cap 10s, merge gap 20s (no unknown), min duration 10s
